source: Open Power System Data, Time series package 2020-10-06
normalisation: Each selected source series is divided by its maximum over the frozen 366-day window.
mapping: The common load factor scales the original 33-bus spatial load allocation; the common solar factor drives three PV units.
scope_note: These public German system-level profiles provide traceable temporal shapes and are not measurements from the IEEE 33-bus feeder.
